evidence_boundary: Retrospective method development/protocol sensitivity only; historical outer results were previously inspected. Not a new blind test or prospective confirmation.
feature_scaling: source train all-row mean and population SD for five nonintercept features; zero SD fails; intercept fixed to zero in pairwise coefficient vector

pair_construction.pool_rule: reuse deterministic v1 sha256(context|train|sequence) complete nonoverlapping 64-item pools
pair_construction.tail: frozen CNN full-pool top16 by stable descending score before labels are used
pair_construction.pairs_per_pool: all 120 unordered pairs within the fixed tail
pair_construction.label: sign(y_i-y_j); exact MRL ties receive zero weight
pair_construction.weight: each source train pool has equal total weight; nontied pairs within a pool have equal weight; global weights sum to one

objective: weighted softplus(-label * (p_i-p_j + sample_train_sd * (z_i-z_j) dot beta)) + lambda * beta_dot_beta

solver.method: convex damped Newton with Armijo backtracking

auxiliary_gate.cluster: target auxiliary test pool; mean over five seeds before resampling pools with replacement

target_if_and_only_if_dual_gate_pass.deployment: equal weight mean of the two selected directional corrections, including their selected strengths; no refit after auxiliary test
target_if_and_only_if_dual_gate_pass.bootstrap_cluster: repeat-linked pool block; all repeats and five seeds move together
success: both repeat cap16 corrected-minus-frozen mean regret differences are negative
combined repeat-linked block bootstrap 95th percentile CI upper bound is below zero
combined absolute mean regret reduction is at least max(0.1 MRL, 5 percent of combined frozen baseline regret)
all isolation, CUDA, numerical, training and calibration logs pass

verification_rounds: round1 implementation, strict input hashes/isolation, focused synthetic and regression tests
round2 independent auxiliary pair/loss/optimizer/selection/regret/bootstrap recomputation and deterministic replay
round3 clean-process delivery verification, tests, hashes and forbidden-export audit
forbidden: No T-cell MRL for training, calibration, pair construction, feature/lambda/strength/subset selection, early stopping, gating, or method changes. No target read if either auxiliary gate fails. No post-target scientific changes.
local_export: Aggregates, coefficients, configs, code and logs only; no sequence strings or sequence-level labels/predictions.
